Sufficient: (chronal form) C.PushUp and every point in Z^+ and Z^-; or (two-sided form) IsLocallyCauchyTwoSided plus J^±_⊤(V) open for every open V; or (gx form) PushUp + Z^+ = M for the past side and two-sidedness + J^+_⊤(V) open for the future side; or (proved form's data) a splitting + IsLocallyCauchyTwoSided. findings: SETTLED under CurvesExtend + PushUp + Z^± = M, NOT as stated: the bare DEC-44 form (isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy) holds, with no splitting and no two-sidedness, as soon as curves extend, C has push-up and every point is strongly tarentin in the past and the future (isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy_of_chronal). None of these three is a hypothesis of the bare form. On every static spacetime ℝ × X over a proper geodesic space it holds (staticCausality.isCauchySurface_of_compact_isLocallyCauchy; connectedness of X is derived); over any geodesic X the bare statement holds VERBATIM for C = staticCausality X (staticCausality.isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy_bare: GH of ℝ × X forces X proper, properSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic). Instances: Minkowski space (checked), the singular-flat massive-particle models E_α, α > 0 (massive_isCauchySurface_of_compact_isLocallyCauchy); ℝ × flat torus is one mathematically but no torus instance is built. For the regular flat quotients Γ\Ω of Rem 2.3 (l.576-578) and §11 (l.3537-3540, 3578-3580) the chronal form is mathematically sufficient (smooth Lorentzian: push-up, Z^± = M, Geroch curve extension); not yet discharged for Γ\Ω in the library (no PushUp, Z^± or CurvesExtend instance under Flat/) — owed by the Theorem B consumer.

The splitting is not what the proof needs: it is sufficient that the strict causal future and past of Σ be open (necessity is not shown), and this core subsumes CompactCauchy's proved form (splitting + two-sided ⇒ the openness, through CompactCauchy's graph step). Acausality then follows from connectedness of Σ alone (the strictly related part of Σ is open by hypothesis, closed because the relation of a GH spacetime is closed and Σ is locally acausal near the diagonal, and misses a ≤-minimal point of Σ found by Zorn on the compact diamonds Σ ∩ J^-(w)); J^+(Σ) ∪ J^-(Σ) is then clopen, hence M. Under that openness hypothesis a 'fold' of Σ (meeting a line twice, winding twice round a cylinder) is excluded by the connectedness step, with no projection.

For gx (BTZ): the bare form is NOT settled. At a BTZ point Z^- fails (SingularFlatAxioms.mem_Zminus_iff) and J^+(Σ)\Σ ≠ I^+(Σ), so only the past side comes for free (push-up and Z^+ = M are fields of SingularFlatAxioms). Sufficient for gx: CurvesExtend (not a field of SingularFlatAxioms; every form here carries it) plus openness of the strict causal future of Σ; the latter follows from two-sidedness in the charts plus 'J^+_⊤(V) open for V open' (isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided_of_pushUp).

No counterexample to the bare form was found. By the chronal form, a counterexample must break at least one of CurvesExtend, PushUp, Z^+ = M, Z^- = M, so it is not static. Local non-static candidates examined (arguments not formalised beyond the named lemmas): the 1-D causalities timelikeLine, lightlikeLine (PushUp vacuous, Z^± = ∅, the library's only BTZAxioms instance), halfChronoLine (Z^- fails at p ≤ -1) — a compact connected locally Cauchy Σ ⊆ ℝ is a point, and a point is Cauchy (timelikeLine_isCauchySurface_singleton, lightlikeLine_isCauchySurface_zero); spacelikeLine violates J^±(p) ≠ {p}; orderLine, timelikeLineTop are non-local (kb/0014); puncturedPlane has PushUp and Z^± = M but is not GH. NOT tried: Pushout gluings and E_{≥0}-manifolds with a BTZ line and a compact Cauchy surface (none constructed in the importable library; E_0 is not built). A counterexample must live in dimension ≥ 2 and break CurvesExtend, push-up or Z^±; the BTZ case is where gx would meet it.
questions: Is J^+_⊤(V) open for every open V in a singular flat spacetime (E_{≥0}-manifold) - i.e. is it future causally open at BTZ lines? If yes (a model fact), the bare form of Lemma K holds for gx through isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided_of_pushUp, given two-sidedness in the charts.

kb_proposals: Lemma K does not need a splitting: it needs the strict causal future/past of Σ open; acausality is then a clopen argument on Σ (Zorn on Σ ∩ J^-(w) for a minimal point), see LemmaKBare.
CurvesExtend.dual now exists (LemmaKBare); together with Inextensible.dual_reverse it lets every curve-extension argument be dualised.
Push-up + Z^- = M ⇒ J^+_⊤(V) open for every open V (isOpen_Jplus_of_pushUp); GH of a static ℝ × X forces X proper (staticCausality.properSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic).
